## State of change 2988 at session halt

`d31375d26a9306b4469db33c04fabdb126ca7fab` — https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2988

**Votes as of 04:02 UTC:**

| label | value | detail |
|---|---|---|
| LLM-Review | **+1 PASS** | 4 advisory comments, unread |
| Verified | **-1 FAILURE** | run 35418894254, job `build-and-test (gate + suite on the patchset)`, cell `pytest (ubuntu-latest, py3.11)` |

**Gotcha for whoever picks this up:** the `/changes/2988/detail` endpoint reported `no vote` for all three labels while the `messages` array in the same response carried both the `LLM-Review+1` and the `Verified-1`. Read `messages`, not `labels`, when polling this endpoint, or a voted change looks untouched.

**What the failure is NOT.** I pulled `--log-failed` and the visible lines were the Gerrit fetch preamble — `fetch_from_gerrit`, `report_error_and_exit`, `git fetch ... refs/changes/88/2988/1` — which is setup scaffolding echoed by `set -x`, not the failing assertion. `error=` came back empty, so the fetch succeeded. **The actual failing test was not identified.** Do not read the preamble as the cause.

**First task on resume:** get the real failure out of run 35418894254. The `py3.11` cell is the one that failed; note the repo's gating cell is `py3.13`, so this is a version-specific failure and worth checking against the new test file's assumptions before assuming a flake. Per project policy an intermittent failure is a bug to root-cause, not a `recheck`.

The change itself is unmodified and still matches the certified `file_impact` — 3 files, `infra/scripts/mcp-entrypoint.sh`, `tests/infra/test_mcp_entrypoint.py`, `infra/runbooks/review-bot-ops.md`. The worktree is at `/Users/joeoakhart/rebar/.rebar/worktrees/fix-8806-workspace-refresh`, clean, commit unpushed beyond patchset 1.

Amend with `git commit -a --amend --no-edit -s` to preserve the `Change-Id`; never `-m` or `-F`, which drop it and open a duplicate change.
